findings.issue: 横になった means 'lay down (on the bed)' — an action. 'I lay awake in bed' adds wakefulness/insomnia not present in the Japanese and drops the lie-down action; pt correctly has 'Eu me deitei na cama'.
findings.suggested: I lay down on the bed.

findings.issue: False derivation claim: どうしていい is not an 'abbreviated' どうしたらいい; it is the て-form + いい construction ('how it would be OK to act'), merely equivalent in meaning. Also contradicts the し token note (て-form of する).
findings.current: The structure is どうしたらいい abbreviated (どうしていい) + か (embedded question) + わからない ('I don't know')
findings.suggested: The structure is どうしていい ('how it would be OK to act'; equivalent to どうしたらいいか) + か (embedded question) + わからない ('I don't know')

findings.issue: Same false derivation claim as expl_en: どうしていい is not どうしたらいい 'abreviada'; it is the て-form + いい pattern, only equivalent in meaning.
findings.current: A estrutura é どうしたらいい abreviada (どうしていい) + か (pergunta embutida) + わからない ('não sei')
findings.suggested: A estrutura é どうしていい ('como seria bom agir'; equivalente a どうしたらいいか) + か (pergunta embutida) + わからない ('não sei')

findings.issue: Typo garbles the form: 'antes de ようにに dar' doubles に (could be read as part of the Japanese form) and drops 'para'; en version reads 'before ように to give'.
findings.current: é nominalizada por か+の antes de ようにに dar 'como se soubesse de tudo'
findings.suggested: é nominalizada por か+の antes de ように para dar 'como se soubesse de tudo'

findings.issue: 'não estou ouvido' is ungrammatical Portuguese and reads as passive ('I am not heard'). The corpus mirrors ている with estar + gerúndio (cf. 'estivesse vendo'), so it should be 'ouvindo'.
findings.current: Ainda, quanto a essa história, não estou ouvido (= não ouvi).
findings.suggested: Ainda, quanto a essa história, não estou ouvindo (= não ouvi).

findings.issue: 'Da tarde de hoje' misrenders 今日の午後に: temporal に maps to 'na' (em+a), not 'da' (de+a); as written it reads 'from/of this afternoon'. Cf. item 1590863 where に is mirrored as 'na'.
findings.current: Da tarde de hoje, ao parque, não vamos? (convite)
findings.suggested: Na tarde de hoje, ao parque, não vamos? (convite)

findings.issue: 横になる = 'become horizontal / lie down', with no specification of lying on one's side; 'lay on my side' adds unsupported body orientation. lit_pt correctly mirrors it as 'na horizontal'.
findings.current: I, on the bed, lay on my side.
findings.suggested: I, on the bed, became horizontal (= lay down).
